scope: Additive Home Village TH18 Super Witch direct-baseline integration. Earlier frozen references and the separate Big Boy mechanics audit remain unmodified.
game_version: The upstream payload is commit 62b019df868f9decb49e97a0ff5ae15fb27af9ba. The dated parent table identifies client build 18.600.3.

sources.title: The February Update has escaped!
sources.limitations: The release note establishes Super Witch level 8 at TH18 but does not publish numerical parent values or a Big Boy lifecycle.

sources.title: Super Witch - Clash of Clans Wiki
sources.limitations: The dated table confirms parent L1-L8 HP and DPS, housing, target type, range, cadence and movement. It does not document splash radius, projectile travel, or Big Boy summon timing.

sources.title: Super Witch/Big Boy
sources.limitations: The page gives Big Boy baseline statistics and one-active-child behaviour, but no version-identified summoning timing, geometry, child level mapping, or visual source.

support.note: Core runs the dated source-backed parent direct primary-target baseline. Splash classification is retained, but no area damage is applied until a radius is sourced. Big Boy is deliberately absent pending a deterministic summoning contract.

changed_values.previous_state: Catalogued-only L5-L8 parent with no Core identifier.
changed_values.replacement: L5-L8 source-backed parent direct baseline materializes through the shared Core path.
changed_values.justification: The parent attack values and cadence are independently usable. Big Boy is not spawned because current public evidence omits a deterministic summon lifecycle.

known_uncertainties: No source gives the Super Witch area splash radius or projectile speed, so Core applies direct primary-target damage only.

No version-identified source defines Big Boy level mapping, initial summon delay, coexistence enforcement, respawn delay, spawn position, target selection, death ordering, trap interaction, or asset path.
The published Big Boy stats are secondary and version-unknown. They are not imported into GameData until a summon contract is available.
conclusion: Super Witch direct parent baseline is executable through Core, CLI, Viewer and RL. Big Boy summoning and area splash remain deliberately disabled and incomplete.
